original.target_description: Experiment 3, first test-phase block: median log response times for correct trials; 2 × 3 mixed ANOVA with test group (factoring versus multiplication) and problem type (factored during practice, multiplied during practice, new); Group × Problem Type interaction.

n.sample_role: Participants in each of two test groups (factor-at-test and multiply-at-test). This is the stated Experiment 3 sample; interaction denominator df = 68 is consistent with both groups contributing.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions stated for Experiment 3. Target RT analysis uses correct trials in the first test block; incorrect trials therefore do not contribute to the RT medians.
n.location: Published p. 551 (PDF p. 6), Experiment 3, Method—Participants; p. 552 (PDF p. 7), Test Phase—Response times.
n.quote: Two groups of 18 volunteers (26 women, 10 men) were recruited through the participant pool at the University of Saskatchewan campus.

es.location: Published p. 552 (PDF p. 7), Test Phase—Response times, right column.
es.quote: There was a robust Group ⫻ Problem Type interaction, F(2, 68) ⫽ 41.59, MSE ⫽ 4,470.55, p ⬍ .001.

p.location: Published p. 552 (PDF p. 7), Test Phase—Response times, right column; same Group × Problem Type interaction.

notes: Original-only blind validation.
